reason: S1 changes wuffs_base__status from const char* to a struct containing repr, but both H0 fuzz functions still store decoder-returned statuses in const char* and use direct pointer truth/equality tests. Because each harness includes the changed release/c/wuffs-unsupported-snapshot.c, H0 is incompatible with S1 and cannot fuzz its existing GIF or zlib paths. In addition, S1 changes the public gzip decoder status-handling path, while H0 has no harness invoking wuffs_gzip__decoder__decode_io_writer.
evidence: S1 declares "typedef struct { const char* repr; ... } wuffs_base__status" and changes helpers such as wuffs_base__status__is_ok to accept "const wuffs_base__status*".

gif_fuzzer.c declares "const char* status" and assigns results from wuffs_gif__decoder__initialize, wuffs_gif__decoder__decode_image_config, wuffs_gif__decoder__decode_frame_config, and wuffs_gif__decoder__decode_frame, all of which return wuffs_base__status in S1.

zlib_fuzzer.c declares "const char* status" and assigns results from wuffs_zlib__decoder__initialize and wuffs_zlib__decoder__decode_io_writer; it also directly compares status with wuffs_base__suspension__short_write.
H0 contains only gif_fuzzer.c and zlib_fuzzer.c, whereas the S1 diff includes changed bodies for wuffs_gzip__decoder__initialize and wuffs_gzip__decoder__decode_io_writer.
recommended_action: Update both H0 fuzz functions to use wuffs_base__status, inspect status through .repr or the pointer-taking status helpers, and compare returned status representations consistently. Then add a gzip decode_io_writer harness, including short-write/resumption behavior and checksum-enabled/ignored variants analogous to the zlib coverage.
